findings: the shipped JSON publishes more decimals than its own computation supports: the U values at L = 300, 1000, 3000, 10000 have incorrect trailing decimals, by up to 3 places. Every leading digit is right; the tail is accumulated rounding from summing L terms at 80 dps.

the shipped constants JSON was not produced by the shipped script: fields are renamed and one top-level key is dropped, so re-running the published program would not reproduce the published file. This is about PROVENANCE and is separate from the precision finding above -- no value is wrong in any digit the computation supports
